national_news.title: India Retains Men's Asian Hockey Championship Title Defeating Japan 4-1
bullets: India secured the 9th Hero Asian Hockey Championship title for the 6th time by defeating Japan 4-1 at the Olympian Balbir Singh Senior International Hockey Stadium in Mohali.
The tournament marked the final international appearance for Indian midfielder Nilakanta Sharma.
Malaysia won the bronze medal in the championship after defeating South Korea 5-2.

national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights Sports Ecosystem and TOPS Scheme While Felicitating Asian Para Games Athletes
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi felicitated the Indian contingent for its record haul of 114 medals (30 gold, 35 silver, 49 bronze) at the Asian Para Games.
Highlighted the government's focus on creating a modern sports ecosystem through Khelo India Centres and the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS).
Noted key milestones including 34 medal wins by female athletes, 5 world records, and 9 Asian records set by the contingent.

national_news.title: India Targets Over $220 Billion Investment to Reach 500 GW Non-Fossil Capacity by 2030
bullets: Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy Pralhad Joshi announced that renewable energy investments are expected to exceed $220 billion to add 190 GW non-fossil power capacity by 2030.
India's installed non-fossil fuel power capacity currently stands at 310 GW, progressing toward the national goal of 500 GW by 2030.
The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy is formulating new guidelines specifically targeting the recycling of solar module waste.

national_news.title: India Observes International Day for Biosphere Reserves Highlighting 18 Notified Sites
bullets: India features a network of 18 nationally notified Biosphere Reserves, 13 of which are part of UNESCO's World Network of Biosphere Reserves.
Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve (established 1986) was India's first biosphere reserve, while Himachal Pradesh's Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve was included in UNESCO's network in 2025.
Biosphere reserves follow a three-tier zoning model comprising Core Areas (~18% globally), Buffer Zones (~30%), and Transition Areas (~52%) to balance conservation with sustainable human development.

national_news.title: Sacred Piprahwa Buddha Relics Exhibited at Tawang Monastery in Arunachal Pradesh
bullets: Over 21,000 devotees visited Gaden Namgyal Lhatse (Tawang Monastery) in Arunachal Pradesh for the sacred exposition of Shakyamuni Buddha relics.
The event was organized by the Ministry of Culture in collaboration with the International Buddhist Confederation (IBC) and the Government of Arunachal Pradesh.
The relics were originally discovered at Piprahwa, Uttar Pradesh in 1898 and are preserved at the National Museum, New Delhi.

national_news.title: India Successfully Tests Indigenous Quasi-Ballistic Missile 'Pralay' Off Odisha Coast
bullets: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully conducted user evaluation trials of the surface-to-surface quasi-ballistic missile 'Pralay' from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island, Odisha.
Pralay is a solid-propellant missile with a strike range of 150 to 500 km, a payload capacity of 500 to 1,000 kg, and an advanced Inertial Navigation System with RF seeker.
Developed by Research Centre Imarat (RCI), Hyderabad, and produced by Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL), the missile features low-altitude in-flight maneuvers to evade interception.

national_news.title: India Wins 9th Hero Asian Hockey Champions Trophy 2026
bullets: Defending champion India defeated Japan 4-1 in the final to lift the Men's Asian Champions Trophy for the 6th time.
The 9th edition of the tournament took place at the Olympian Balbir Singh Senior International Hockey Stadium in Mohali.
Hockey India announced a cash reward of Rs. 3 lakhs for each player and Rs. 1.5 lakhs for each support staff member.

national_news.title: India's Renewable Energy Investments Expected to Exceed $220 Billion by 2030
bullets: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi announced at the Bharat Renewable Energy (BRE) Summit 2026 that India expects to exceed its $220 billion investment target for non-fossil fuel power capacity.
India aims to achieve 500 GW of installed non-fossil fuel power capacity by 2030, with current capacity standing at 310 GW.
The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy is preparing new guidelines for recycling solar module waste.

national_news.title: India's Biosphere Reserves: Connecting Conservation with Livelihoods
bullets: India has 18 notified biosphere reserves, out of which 13 belong to UNESCO’s World Network of Biosphere Reserves, the highest in South Asia.
Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve (designated in 1986) was India's first biosphere reserve, spanning Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka.
The International Day for Biosphere Reserves is observed annually on November 3.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Key Schemes for Fast-Track Courts, Energy Storage, Statistical Reforms, and Critical Minerals
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the Centrally Sponsored Scheme for Fast Track Special Courts (exclusive POCSO courts) for five years starting April 1, 2026, with a total outlay of Rs 3,788.04 crore (Central share of Rs 2,353.15 crore funded via the Nirbhaya Fund).

Approved a Rs 14,500 crore Viability Gap Funding (VGF) Scheme to build 92 GWh grid-scale energy storage capacity by 2030–31 (60 GWh pumped hydro, 30 GWh battery storage, and 2 GWh emerging technologies), requiring a minimum 40% domestic content for battery projects.

Sanctioned the Viksit Bharat Initiative for Statistical Transformation, Analytics & Research (VISTAR) for modernizing national statistics using AI, alongside a new capital subsidy scheme to boost domestic processing of critical minerals like lithium, nickel, and cobalt.

bihar_news.title: Andhra Pradesh Tops Ease of Vehicle Ownership Index; Bihar Ranks Near Bottom
bullets: Andhra Pradesh topped the first Ease of Vehicle Ownership Index (EVOI) released by IndiaTech.org and Consumer VOICE, scoring 5.91 out of 10.
Uttar Pradesh ranked last at 2.47, just behind Bihar at 2.51 and West Bengal at 2.56 among the 15 assessed States and UTs.
The index evaluates six pillars including policy framework, digital infrastructure, process efficiency, transparency, institutional ecosystem, and cost/affordability.

bihar_news.title: Indian Railways Operates Special Trains for Bihar Festivals and Prakash Parv
bullets: Indian Railways operated 15,000 trains to and from Bihar to manage passenger traffic during Diwali and Chhath Puja, as announced by Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw.
Special services were also scheduled between January 9 and 16 for Prakash Parv celebrations at Patna Sahib.
Proposals include introducing a Vande Bharat Express between Sitamarhi and Ayodhya to enhance regional connectivity.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Orders Monthly Business Meets to Boost Industrial Policy
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister directed Industries Minister Shreyasi Singh and district authorities to conduct monthly meetings with entrepreneurs for faster grievance redressal.
The announcement was made at the 82nd annual function of the Bihar Industries Association (BIA).
The government invited a draft proposal from entrepreneurs for formulating a dedicated state pharmaceutical policy.

bihar_news.title: PM Modi's Proposed Visit to Bihar to Feature Patna-Purnia Expressway and Other Infrastructure Projects
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to visit Vaishali, Bihar, to address a public meeting and potentially inaugurate construction on the Patna-Purnia Expressway.
The Patna-Purnia Expressway is Bihar's proposed first national six-lane greenfield expressway, connecting Mirnagar in Vaishali to Chand Bhatti in Purnia across five districts.
The visit may also include foundation stone laying for a central university near Vikramshila and the Ajgaibinath Greenfield Airport in Bhagalpur district.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Targets 3 Lakh Rural Projects Worth Rs 22,000 Crore Under VB-G RAM G Mission
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary directed officials to accelerate the Viksit Bharat-Rozgar evam Aajeevika Guarantee Mission-Rural (VB-G RAM G), targeting 3 lakh projects worth Rs 22,000 crore.
The mission aims to provide 125 days of guaranteed employment annually to rural households with wage disbursal mandated within 15 days.
Key intervention areas include water security, rural infrastructure, livelihood enhancement, disaster management, and construction of Anganwadi centres, school classrooms, and healthcare facilities.

bihar_news.title: Patna-Purnia Greenfield Expressway Planned as Bihar's First National Expressway
bullets: The proposed six-lane greenfield Patna-Purnia Expressway is set to begin at Mirnagar on NH-22 in Vaishali district and terminate at Chand Bhatti on NH-27 in Purnia.
The expressway alignment traverses five key districts: Samastipur, Darbhanga, Saharsa, Madhepura, and Purnia, enhancing east-west connectivity across northern and eastern Bihar.
Upcoming infrastructure proposals in the region also include a Central University near Vikramshila and the Ajgaibinath Greenfield Airport near Sultanganj in Bhagalpur district.
